gate-residual-company-suffix-before-a-ca: An unlisted abbreviation before a capitalised name ('…from Acme Ltd. Partners only if…') still lets a quote stop mid-sentence. Open deliberately: the fix is to add company suffixes to _NON_TERMINAL_ABBREVIATIONS, which was measured to cost three legitimate quote shapes (gate-accept-sentence-final-company-suffixes) to close this one. Revisit if a pilot shows it biting — the trade is priced by the two cases, not by argument.
apply-replace-across-tracked-deletion: Waits on a real-Word observation: what a tracked replace does to a range that already holds a tracked deletion. The matcher now locates the raw stretch; the fake throws rather than guess what Word does next. Measured in the sideload of fix/apply-across-tracked-deletion, then the fake models it and this entry goes.
